title: Validate JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model against OpenClaw 2026.3.11 breaking change
summary: OpenClaw 2026.3.11 removed agent-send from isolated cron jobs. JOB-CI-001 execution profile may be affected. Needs validation and profile update if broken.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16) flagged that JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model may be affected by OpenClaw 2026.3.11 breaking change: isolated cron jobs can no longer perform ad-hoc agent sends. The weekly release delta review (2026-03-16 09:20) confirmed this as a known breaking change. Validation required: (1) check if JOB-CI-001 uses isolated-cron agent-sends; (2) if yes, apply doctor --fix or update delivery model to use announce delivery with webhook/channel output; (3) run smoke test post-fix; (4) update cron post-update smoke checklist to include cron delivery validation.
desired_outcome: JOB-CI-001 validated against new cron delivery constraints; profile updated if broken; smoke test green; checklist updated.
success_signal: JOB-CI-001 cron runs without delivery errors under OpenClaw 2026.3.x constraints.
